title: Post hoc field-spectrum check of the AquaCorr-Global v1 NIR upper tail
status: Locally frozen before the first field-versus-satellite outcome comparison; not an external preregistration
prior_exposure: The prior AquaCorr numerical audit and its high-NIR outcomes were known. Before this protocol, a format/feasibility scan revealed 1535 GLORIA-labelled matchups and 52 with native satellite NIR >0.30 sr^-1; no field-versus-satellite Rrs comparison had been calculated.
primary_eligibility: Exact source=GLORIA and valid GLORIA_ID join to the original PANGAEA files
AquaCorr passed_qc=True and finite native NIR Rrs
GLORIA Flagged=0; flagged field spectra retained in an inclusive sensitivity analysis
Same UTC calendar date and at most 3 hours between field measurement and satellite overpass
Field and AquaCorr coordinates at most 100 m apart, interpreted as a spatial consistency screen rather than exact pixel geolocation
Published spectral response with at least 99% response area between 350 and 900 nm and finite field spectrum over non-negligible response
landsat_5_handling: Exclude from primary bandpass calculation because a suitable public Landsat-5 VNIR response curve was not yet secured; report its count, and do not substitute a single wavelength as if bandpass-convolved.
bandpass_method: Piecewise-linear interpolation of 1-nm GLORIA Rrs at sensor-response wavelengths, followed by trapezoidal integration of Rrs(lambda)*RSR(lambda) / integral RSR(lambda), in wavelength units. L7/L8 EUMETSAT response wavenumbers are converted to nm by 1e7 / cm^-1. Sentinel-2A/B uses v4 B8A response; use of 2026 v5 is a sensitivity check.
outcomes: Signed and absolute native NIR Rrs error = AquaCorr satellite minus convolved GLORIA field, units sr^-1
Counts of high satellite NIR (>0.30 sr^-1) and field-bandpass NIR above the same threshold, among all primary-eligible pairs
Medians and IQR by sensor, with site/scene distinct counts; descriptive, with no unclustered inferential p-value
sensitivity: Include GLORIA Flagged=1 while retaining other filters
limitations: GLORIA measurements are external to satellite ACOLITE processing but were already used by the AquaCorr publisher; they are not an untouched holdout. Comparison alone cannot identify contamination mechanism or establish a general-purpose error classifier. GLORIA ends at 900 nm and cannot validate SWIR.
